skill.name: pdf-processing
skill.description: Extract text, tables, form data, and page-level content from PDFs. Use this skill for PDF analysis, form workflows, and document operations.
skill.summary: Extract PDF text, tables, forms, and pages with practical library guidance.
skill.author: 0xkynz

security_audit.summary: The only static finding points to a Markdown Python code fence in SKILL.md, not actual shell execution. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or unsafe behavioral instruction was found in the reviewed skill text.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md lines 14-19 contain a fenced Python example using pdfplumber, not Ruby backtick or shell execution. The snippet is documentation only and does not define executable skill code.

content.value_statement: PDF workflows often require text, tables, forms, and page operations across inconsistent documents. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical PDF processing tasks.
actual_capabilities: Extract text from single pages or complete PDF documents.
Identify and extract tables for structured review or export.
Work with PDF form fields and fillable document workflows.
Plan merge, split, rotation, and watermark operations.
Recommend suitable Python libraries for extraction and manipulation.
limitations: Scanned PDFs may need OCR before text extraction works.
Complex layouts can require manual validation after extraction.
Encrypted PDFs require valid access before processing.
The skill gives guidance and examples, not a bundled executable tool.

use_cases.title: Extract Contract Tables
use_cases.description: Pull tables and key text from contract PDFs for review and reporting.

use_cases.title: Automate Form Workflows
use_cases.description: Read and fill repeatable PDF forms with consistent field handling.

use_cases.title: Prepare Document Batches
use_cases.description: Plan merging, splitting, rotation, and watermark steps for PDF batches.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Basic Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner extraction from a simple PDF.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text from this PDF and summarize the main sections. Note any pages where extraction appears incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Find Tables
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the tables from this PDF report. Preserve row labels, column headings, and page references.

prompt_templates.title: Review Form Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this fillable PDF form. List the fields, expected values, validation concerns, and safe fill order.

prompt_templates.title: Design Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PDF processing workflow for these documents. Include extraction, validation, merge rules, and error handling steps.

output_examples.input: A user asks to extract text from a ten-page policy PDF.
output_examples.output: A page-by-page text summary with notes for missing text, unusual formatting, and pages that may need OCR.

output_examples.input: A user provides a PDF invoice with tables.
output_examples.output: A clean table summary with invoice fields, line items, totals, and page references for verification.

output_examples.input: A user needs to combine several PDF files into one packet.
output_examples.output: A merge plan that orders documents, checks page orientation, and identifies where watermarks or rotations are needed.

best_practices: Check encryption and permissions before attempting extraction.
Validate extracted text and tables against the source pages.
Use pdfplumber for extraction and PyPDF2 for page manipulation.
anti_patterns: Assuming scanned pages contain extractable text without OCR.
Trusting extracted tables without comparing them to the PDF layout.
Merging documents without checking page order, rotation, and duplicate pages.

faq.question: Can this skill process scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: It can identify when OCR is needed, but scanned images need an OCR tool before normal text extraction.

faq.question: Does this skill include executable code?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for using common PDF libraries.

faq.question: Which libraries does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends pdfplumber for extraction and PyPDF2 for common document manipulation tasks.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports table extraction guidance and encourages validation for complex layouts.

faq.question: Can it fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes form field extraction and fillable form workflows.

faq.question: Is it safe for confidential documents?
faq.answer: Review your tool environment first. The skill itself does not add network or storage behavior.
